items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: When Phil Woods went to Juilliard he could not major in saxophone.

ctx.x: Well you’re working for a college. I don’t know how helpful anything I’m saying here is for the institution but, you know, there it is. And it’s certainly true of hillbilly music too. That hasn’t happened. Why doesn’t Juilliard give courses in playing steel guitar? It’s a very sophisticated complicated instrument that’s constantly being worked on and revised with new techniques that players have and by, you know, new inventions and everything on the instrument. How come that’s not in an institution of higher…
Interesting is right. When Phil Woods went to Juilliard he could not major in saxophone. He had to major in clarinet.
Is that right? I didn’t know that.
